description.value: Feast is one of three UBC Vancouver residence dining halls, located in Totem Park Residence and open to the general public. It houses multiple made-to-order stations — Mexican, South Asian, Italian stone-hearth pizza, North American diner classics, and salads — with over 60% of ingredients sourced locally from UBC Farm and other BC producers. The menu features Ocean Wise seafood, certified halal beef, and a range of vegan and vegetarian options, making it a substantial refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the UBC endowment lands.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (40 spaces, covered) at 34m; rack at 68m; stands (24 spaces) at 69m; lockers (40 spaces, covered, secure) at 76m; stands (50 spaces, covered) at 98m; rack (covered) at 98m. Total: 154 spaces, 40 secure.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Feast is a publicly accessible UBC residence dining hall at Totem Park Residence, 2525 West Mall, Vancouver, with multiple globally-inspired stations including explicit vegan and vegetarian options ('a variety of vegan and vegetarian options'). The OSM address field ('2525 Totem Park Residence') omits the street name; the website clarifies it as '2525 West Mall'. The website notes the venue is closed for Summer Break but operates during fall/winter terms, and accepts public visitors; no evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi for diners beyond the unconfirmed OSM internet_access=wlan tag.

Currently closed for Summer Break at time of data fetch (2026-05-28); this is a seasonal closure, not permanent — the venue operates during fall/winter academic terms.
Phone number (604-822-3663) is the general UBC Food Services office line sourced from the website contact page, not a direct line for Feast; OSM has no phone entry.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible dining hall on the UBC campus; website explicitly confirms it is open to the public, not just residents.
enrichment_extras.notes: Payment accepted: Residence Meal Plan, UBCcard Value Plan, Departmental Food Plan, Carryover Plan, UBC Guest Cards, debit, and credit. Seasonal operation: fall and winter terms only; closed summers.
